covers: North West; Free State (except the Vrede area)
why: The maize belt west of Gauteng. Semi-arid summer rainfall that falls off to the west. With the Highveld it grows most of South Africa's maize.
The eastern maize belt and the industrial heartland. Wetter and cooler than the west.
Warmer, subtropical north-east. Fruit, vegetables, cattle and game.
Wet summer rainfall below the escarpment. Dairy, maize, timber and sugar.

covers: Former Transkei; Komani (Queenstown) area; north-eastern Eastern Cape highlands; Kokstad
why: Summer rainfall, with more rain outside summer than the interior. Communal farming and livestock.
Winter rainfall (April to September). Wheat, fruit and wine. In summer it is tracked for heat; its rain is tracked in its own winter season.
